about_the_game:
The Rain Dancer will bring rays of sunlight to your mercenary party. Her ability 'Sunlight' will disperse any clouds that are present on the field while providing a 'x2 Merit' buff for a duration tied to her mercenary level. When the Rain Dancer is prestiged, collecting her ability token will trigger 'Sunlight' for other players within your playtime range.

Base Stats
  • Health: 10
  • Energy: 14
  • Attack: 1
  • Gather Amount: 20
  • Convert Amount: 100
Prestige Party Buff
  • + 20% Gathered Merit
  • + Periodically grants other players 'Sunlight'
Sunlight
  • Grants x2 Merit gathered by mercenaries for a period of time. This scales with mercenary level.
